body.p: After . Owns src/schema_simple_type.c, src/types.c (the sxml_type_registry_register_schema_type of and describing registered schema types), src/cast.c, src/cast_lexical.c, src/regex.c, src/regex_internal.h, tests/schema_simple_type_test.c, tests/cast_test.c, tests/regex_test.c, tests/types_test.c. Simple type definitions: restriction, list and union (Part 2, 4.1), facet applicability by primitive type and the facets' own constraints (Part 2, 4.3: length and minLength/maxLength consistency, bounds, totalDigits and fractionDigits, fixed facets, whiteSpace, explicitTimezone), the canonical facet values of types.h, registration in derivation order. Casting to registered atomic, list and union types in src/cast.c: the whitespace facet, then the lexical mapping of the primitive type, then every facet of the type and its bases (cvc-facet-valid, cvc-pattern-valid, cvc-enumeration-valid, ...): one lexical-space engine, the cast engine, for XSD and XPath alike. The regex engine's XSD dialect: a flag of sxml_regex_flags () that anchors the pattern to the whole value and rejects what the XSD 1.1 grammar lacks (back-references, reluctant quantifiers, non-capturing groups, lookaround, ^ and $ as anchors; Part 2, appendix G). Done when MS-DataTypes, MS-Regex, MS-SimpleType, NIST ≥ 90% under the driver once 5.4 and 5.7 run them (unit tests before: cast of "5" to a restriction of xs:integer with minInclusive 10 raises FORG0001 with cvc-minInclusive-valid in the description). Golden: src/cast.c, src/types.c. Done 2026-10-18 (): facets in the cast engine (src/cast_facet.c, hooked into src/cast.c), the regex engine's XSD dialect, schema type registration in src/types.c, SIMPLE_TYPES in src/schema_simple_type.c with tests/schema_simple_type_test.c; the packet's unit test passes. Schema tests: NIST 100 %, MS-Regex 100 %, MS-DataTypes 99.7 %, MS-SimpleType 96.4 %; the ≥ 90 % of the instance tests is measured once 5.7 validates.
